thesis: The site's primary conversion mechanism is guiding visitors from the hero to a product page and into the cart, but this path is diluted by competing CTAs, vague hero copy, and a prominent shipping delay warning that undermines trust. The most valuable fix is to unify the hero CTA to a single 'Shop All' action and replace the delay warning with a reassuring message, which directly addresses the highest-friction elements on the homepage.

findings.title: Competing primary CTAs
findings.summary: Two equally prominent CTAs in the hero split user attention and dilute the primary conversion path.
findings.problem: Two equally prominent CTAs in the hero split user attention and dilute the primary conversion path.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: Shop All; notes: Use a single primary CTA to 'Shop All' to reduce friction and let users explore without an initial gender choice.
findings.evidence: Hero section contains both 'SHOP MEN' and 'SHOP WOMEN' CTAs, with no single primary action. | H1: 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' CTAs: 'SHOP MEN' and 'SHOP WOMEN' with no subheadline to clarify the brand's specific benefits.
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 2.0-8.0% relative lift x $78 order value

findings.title: Shipping delay warning
findings.summary: The prominent 'orders may take up to 30 days to ship' warning creates immediate purchase hesitation and undermines trust in delivery reliability.
findings.problem: The prominent 'orders may take up to 30 days to ship' warning creates immediate purchase hesitation and undermines trust in delivery reliability.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: SHOP MEN / SHOP WOMEN; notes: Replace with a reassuring message like 'Free shipping on orders over $100' or 'Most orders ship within 2-3 days' and move any delay notice to a less prominent location or provide an option for expedited shipping.
findings.evidence: Body sample: 'Due to increased demand, orders may take up to 30 days to ship.' appears prominently near the top of the page.
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 2.0-8.0% relative lift x $78 order value

findings.title: Vague hero copy
findings.summary: The hero headline 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' is abstract and doesn't directly address the visitor's intent to find comfortable, sustainable shoes, leaving them to infer the value proposition.
findings.problem: The hero headline 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' is abstract and doesn't directly address the visitor's intent to find comfortable, sustainable shoes, leaving them to infer the value proposition.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Shoes That Feel Like Clouds, Made from the Earth; cta: Shop Men's Shoes / Shop Women's Shoes; notes: A more concrete headline that directly states the dual benefit of comfort and sustainability, with CTAs that specify the product category.
findings.evidence: H1: 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' CTAs: 'SHOP MEN' and 'SHOP WOMEN' with no subheadline to clarify the brand's specific benefits.
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 2.0-8.0% relative lift x $78 order value

findings.title: Free shipping threshold hidden
findings.summary: The homepage hero promotes 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' without mentioning the $100 free shipping threshold, which is only disclosed in the sitewide banner and cart, creating an expectation of free shipping that may not be met.
findings.problem: The homepage hero promotes 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' without mentioning the $100 free shipping threshold, which is only disclosed in the sitewide banner and cart, creating an expectation of free shipping that may not be met.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural. Free Shipping Over $100; cta: SHOP MEN / SHOP WOMEN; notes: Add free shipping threshold to hero or subheadline to set accurate expectations.
findings.evidence: Homepage hero copy: 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' Sitewide banner: 'Free ground shipping on orders over $100' Cart drawer: 'Spend more to earn free shipping! Shipping $5.00'
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

findings.title: Mega-menu choice overload
findings.summary: The mega-menu presents 20+ nav items with multiple sub-levels, risking choice overload and decision paralysis for users.
findings.problem: The mega-menu presents 20+ nav items with multiple sub-levels, risking choice overload and decision paralysis for users.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: SHOP MEN / SHOP WOMEN; notes: Reduce top-level nav items to 5-7, consolidate sub-categories, and use clear labels to reduce cognitive load.
findings.evidence: nav_items list contains 20 items including 'New Arrivals', 'Shop All', 'Bestsellers', 'LEATHER ALTERNATIVES', 'Men's Shoes', 'Sneakers', 'Slip Ons', 'Sandals', 'Active', 'All-Weather', 'Runner NZ', 'Cruiser', 'Tree Runner NZ', 'Socks', 'Men's Apparel', 'Women's Shoes', 'Trainers', 'Flats', 'Canvas Cruiser', 'Women's Apparel'.
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

findings.title: Heavy third-party script load
findings.summary: The homepage loads 63 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
findings.problem: The homepage loads 63 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Audit third-party tags, defer non-critical scripts, and remove duplicated analytics or marketing pixels.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 41 inline and 22 external <script> tags, 707 KB of HTML.
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

findings.title: Hidden cost: shipping fee
findings.summary: Free shipping threshold is not clearly communicated on product pages, risking surprise at checkout.
findings.problem: Free shipping threshold is not clearly communicated on product pages, risking surprise at checkout.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Anytime Ankle Sock; cta: Add to Cart; notes: Display 'Free shipping on orders over $100' near the price or add-to-cart button to set expectations and encourage larger orders.
findings.evidence: Product page shows 'Get Notified' and 'Learn More' CTAs but no mention of free shipping threshold; cart drawer shows 'Shipping $5.00' and 'Spend more to earn free shipping!'
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

findings.title: Missing review count
findings.summary: The product page shows a reviews section but lacks a visible review count or rating summary, reducing social proof and increasing uncertainty about product quality.
findings.problem: The product page shows a reviews section but lacks a visible review count or rating summary, reducing social proof and increasing uncertainty about product quality.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Anytime Ankle Sock; cta: Add to Cart; notes: Add a star rating and review count (e.g., '4.8/5 from 1,200+ reviews') directly under the product title or near the price to provide immediate social proof.
findings.evidence: H2s include 'Reviews for Anytime Ankle Sock' but no review count or star rating is visible in the provided content.
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

findings.title: Controls without accessible names
findings.summary: 41 of 79 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
findings.problem: 41 of 79 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Give every control a visible text label or an aria-label. WCAG 2.2 AA, success criterion 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 41 of 79 <button> elements contain no text content and no aria-label.
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

findings.title: Images missing alternative text
findings.summary: 3 of 43 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
findings.problem: 3 of 43 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add descriptive alt text; use alt="" only for decorative images.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 3 of 43 elements have no alt attribute.
findings.opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 0.5-2.0% relative lift x $78 order value
